size.$description: Sizes of elements set inside a component.

icon.$description: An icon next to body text: the 24px grid of the icons.

icon-sm.$description: Width and height of a small icon inside a control: the chevrons of the components.

choice.$description: The box of a checkbox or of a radio, and the thumb of a switch, next to body text.

panel.$description: The inline size of a panel along an edge of the page: a drawer.

popup.$description: The largest block size of a popup, like a list of suggestions: its content scrolls past it.

indicator-sm.$description: A small loading or progress indicator, inside a control.

indicator-md.$description: A loading or progress indicator next to body text.

indicator-lg.$description: A loading indicator that stands for a whole region.

table.$description: The largest block size of a table: none by default, the page scrolls.

body.$description: Text of the page and of the components.

width.$description: The border of a form control, like a text field.

width-thick.$description: A line that carries information: the ring of a spinner, a progress bar.

focus-ring.$description: The focus indicator, the same in every component.

overlay.$description: A popup outside the top layer, in the browsers without the Popover API.

raised.$description: A surface above the page, like a card.

overlay.$description: A surface above everything, like a modal.

duration.$description: Zero when the user asks for reduced motion (motion.reduced), but `loop`, slower.

loop.$description: One turn of an animation that repeats while something loads.

scale.$description: One when the user asks for reduced motion (motion.reduced).

enter.$description: The scale an overlay enters from and leaves to, like a modal.
